rows.en:
(A new planet's been found...
It still doesn't feel real at all.)

\p,
what are you doing spacing out in a place like this?

Oh, Klan-senpai.
It's just... it still hasn't really sunk in
that a new planet's been found...

Why are you thinking such complicated thoughts?
A new planet's been found. Isn't that enough?
W-Well, yes, but...

We've been voyaging all this time in search
of a place to call home. For now, just be glad
that a new planet has been found.
rows.notes: anju no chi: a place to settle in peace (the fleet's search for a home).

rows.en:
You're right...
There's no need to overthink it, is there?
Mm! Naturally!

(Yeah, Klan-senpai's right.
I was just overcomplicating things.)
(Honestly, I'm no match for Klan-senpai.)

(A new planet's been found...
It still doesn't feel real at all.)
rows.notes: Female twin of c17136; shared with nml_pnn_003 (female).

rows.en:
(Yeah, Klan-senpai's right.
I was just overcomplicating things.)
(Honestly, I'm no match for Klan-senpai.)

(Okay, I came to buy a late-night snack,
but what should I get?)

What on earth are you doing
at this hour, \p?

Oh, Klan-senpai.
I got hungry, so I came to buy
a late-night snack.
Snacking at this hour? You'll get fat, you know.

I'll burn off whatever I eat in class,
so I'm sure I'll be fine.

I see... If only all the nutrients I eat
would go straight to my height and my chest...
Ugh, saying that out loud made me sad...
Well then, see you...
(Klan-senpai has it rough in all sorts of ways too, huh.)

(Okay, I came to buy a late-night snack,
but what should I get?)
(Klan-senpai has it rough in all sorts of ways too, huh.)
(No way... The city's been destroyed this badly......)

\p!
What on earth are you doing here?

Klan-senpai...
I thought I should see the damaged areas
for myself, but...
I never thought it would be this bad...

\p...
What we need to do right now
is not stand here grieving.

If you have time to grieve, there must be
something else you can do, right?

Besides, I won't let them do as they please
any longer! I... I'll stop them myself!!
rows.notes: 'them' = the attackers (yatsura, unnamed; the Vajra in context).

rows.en:
(Klan-senpai's doing her best too.
If there's something I can do... then I will too!)

(Klan-senpai's doing her best too.
If there's something I can do... then I will too!)

(Phew~ The tests are over,
so maybe I'll just have all the fun I want today.)

You look awfully pleased with yourself,
but how did your tests go,
\p?

Klan-senpai...
The tests are finally over, so please
let me forget about reality just for now.
Such spoiled, soft-headed talk...

...is what I'd usually say,
but I'll let you off the hook just for today.

Thank you!
Oh, I know! Klan-senpai, want to come hang out too?
I promised Michel and the others that later......
Michel!?
...Oh, fine. I suppose I'll tag along.
Hurry up, let's go! \p!

(Maybe for Klan-senpai, getting to see Michel
beats the tests being over?)

Thank you!
Oh, I know! Klan-senpai, want to come hang out too?
I promised Michel-kun and the others that later......

(Maybe for Klan-senpai, getting to see Michel-kun
beats the tests being over?)

(I forgot we have class in another room today!
I've gotta hurry!)
rows.notes: idou kyoushitsu: a class held away from the homeroom.

rows.en: Nwaah!

Owww...
S-Sorry, Klan-senpai...

Watch where you're going!
It's a good thing I was micronized, or else...
Sorry...

Next time you bump into me, I'll be macronized!
You'd better be ready!

(If I bumped into a macronized Klan-senpai,
I'd get a lot worse than a few bruises...)

(I forgot we have class in another room today!
I'd better hurry!)

Ooh...
S-Sorry, Klan-senpai...

(If I bumped into a macronized Klan-senpai,
I'd get a lot worse than a few bruises...)

(Phew~ EX-Gear training class
really wears me out.)
You look worn out, \p.
Oh, Klan-senpai.

I watched you all flying from the classroom.
You fly beautifully. Not bad at all.
Mm. Keep honing your skills, young man.
rows.notes: shounen: 'young man' as in frd_kln_001 / frd_kln_113.

rows.en:
(Klan-senpai praised me...
But why was she watching our class?)
(Maybe she was watching Michel...?)

(Phew~ EX-Gear training class
really wears me out.)
Mm. Keep honing your skills.

(Klan-senpai praised me...
But why was she watching our class?)
(Maybe she was watching Michel-kun...?)
